description: Defines the ul_srs_pdu_builder class, a builder for constructing and setting parameters of ul_srs_pdu objects related to uplink SRS PDU configuration in 5G NR protocol, with methods for setting various parameters as per SCF-222 specifications.

classes.name: ul_srs_pdu_builder
classes.description: A builder class for configuring ul_srs_pdu objects with various parameters related to uplink SRS PDU.

methods.name: set_ue_specific_parameters
methods.description: Sets the UE-specific parameters in the PDU based on RNTI.

methods.name: set_bwp_parameters
methods.description: Sets BWP parameters including BWP, subcarrier spacing, and cyclic prefix.

methods.name: set_timing_params
methods.description: Sets timing parameters such as start position, periodicity, and offset.

methods.name: set_comb_params
methods.description: Sets comb size and offset parameters.

methods.name: set_report_params
methods.description: Enables or disables normalized IQ matrix and positioning reports.

methods.name: set_frequency_params
methods.description: Sets frequency-related parameters including position, shift, hopping, and group/sequence hopping.

methods.name: set_srs_params
methods.description: Configures SRS resource parameters such as antenna ports, symbols, repetitions, sequence ID, bandwidth, cyclic shift, and resource type.
